draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Velankanni! This little coastal town is home to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, which Pope John XXIII called 'the Lourdes of the East', and its annual novena draws nearly 5 million pilgrims a year.
draft.hungryLine: Pilgrim streets near the basilica are lined with simple eateries, so grab a quick bite between visits.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health is a 14 min walk from here, and the Vellayar, a small branch of the Cauvery, meets the sea just south of town.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk down to the Bay of Bengal shore and watch the waves after visiting the basilica.
moodReplies.surprise-me: A canal built to link Velankanni with Vedaranyam still lies just west of town.

spots.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health
spots.detail: 14 min walk · The great Marian shrine, a minor basilica since 1962

spots.name: Vellayar
spots.detail: South of town · A minor branch of the Cauvery flowing out to the sea

legends.title: Three miracles
legends.body: Devotion here goes back to three stories: the Madonna and Child appearing to a sleeping shepherd boy, a handicapped buttermilk vendor being healed, and Portuguese sailors surviving a deadly storm. The sailors built the first small chapel after they washed ashore.

tips.title: Expect novena crowds.
tips.body: The annual novena brings nearly 5 million pilgrims, so plan stays and travel well ahead if you come then.

tips.title: Take the train in.
tips.body: Velankanni railway station is a terminal station just a 4 min walk from here.

story.title: The devotion begins
story.body: Devotion to Our Lady at Velankanni dates back to the mid-sixteenth century. It grew from a vision, a healing and a rescue at sea.

story.title: A sailors' chapel
story.body: Portuguese sailors from Goa and Bombay survived a severe tempest and washed ashore here. They built a modest chapel in thanks.

story.title: Lourdes of the East
story.body: Pope John XXIII made the shrine a minor basilica on 3 November 1962. He called it 'the Lourdes of the East' for its huge crowds.

story.title: Tsunami and after
story.body: Velankanni was among the worst hit towns in the 2004 tsunami. Today it's one of India's heritage cities under the HRIDAY scheme.
